name: Nadia Agatram
original_name: ナーティア・アガトラム
source:
Princess from a parallel world. Not well equipped with knowledge of the outside world, she doesn’t understand quite a lot sometimes. Very straightforward and does what she believes is right. 

[Edited from Accany Wordpress]
